name: B Formulas Brightening Vitamin C Daily Moisturizer 100ml
description:
Beauty Formulas Brightening Vitamin C Daily Moisturizer 100ml 
Deep hydration: Provides long-lasting moisture to keep skin feeling soft, supple, and hydrated throughout the day. 

Vitamin C complex: Rich in vitamins B, C, and E to nourish and revitalize the skin. 

Brightening and illuminating effect: Targets dark spots, hyperpigmentation, and uneven skin tone for a brighter, more radiant complexion. 

Antioxidant protection: Shields the skin from free radical damage, preventing premature aging and dullness. 

Lightweight and non-greasy: Absorbs quickly without leaving a sticky or oily residue. 

MADE IN UK
